en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a cargo ship named BIRKALAND at sea, accompanied by a small tugboat in the foreground. The ship's superstructure, masts, and rigging are clearly visible. Printed caption text at the bottom left gives technical details about the vessel, and at the bottom right it credits the shipping line and its home port, Svenska Orient Linien, Gothenburg.
